
```{r, include=FALSE}
# =============================================================================
# CPA SUBSECTION (child of adu_permit_pipeline.Rmd). Called once per CPA with
# this_cpa set. Outputs, in order: tract outline map, land use summary, eligible
# lots map; ADU units by status, ADUs by property type, two cumulative charts,
# ADU projects map; community profile, four tract maps, the layered tract map;
# working-class demographics and ADU tables.
# =============================================================================
cc <- this_cpa
bd <- filter(cpa_sf, cpa == cc)
xw_cc <- tract_xwalk %>% filter(cpa == cc)
tr_cc <- tracts_sf %>% filter(CT20 %in% xw_cc$CT20)
tr_clip <- st_intersection(tr_cc, st_geometry(bd)) %>% st_collection_extract("POLYGON") %>%
  group_by(CT20, LABEL) %>% summarise(.groups = "drop")
ls_cc <- land_tbl %>% filter(cpa == cc)
as_cc <- adu_tbl %>% filter(cpa == cc)
a_cc  <- adu_focus %>% filter(cpa == cc)
p_cc  <- prop_sf %>% filter(cpa == cc)
older_cc <- sum(p_cc$older_adu, na.rm = TRUE)
as_sf_cc <- adu_tbl_sf %>% filter(cpa == cc)
tag_cc <- a_cc %>% count(source_tag, wt = units, .drop = FALSE)
id <- gsub("[^a-z]", "", tolower(cc))
```

```{r, results='asis'}
            cc, fmt(ls_cc$r1), fmt(ls_cc$r2), fmt(ls_cc$eB), window_label, fmt(as_cc$projects), fmt(as_cc$units),
```

```{r, fig.width=8.5, fig.height=7.5}
# ---- Tract outline map: the CPA and its tracts -----------------------------------------------
outside <- st_difference(st_union(tr_cc), st_union(bd))
hatch <- hatch_lines(outside, n = 90)
frame_geom <- st_union(c(st_geometry(tr_cc), st_geometry(bd)))
neighbors <- cpa_sf %>% filter(cpa != cc) %>% st_filter(st_buffer(frame_geom, 3000))
bm <- bm_for(frame_geom, tiles = 4)
bbm <- st_bbox(st_transform(st_buffer(frame_geom, 1500), crs_map))
g <- ggplot() +
  basemap_layer(bm, fade = 0.35) +
  geom_sf(data = st_transform(neighbors, crs_map), fill = NA, color = "grey60", linewidth = 0.3, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_sf_text(data = st_transform(st_point_on_surface(neighbors), crs_map), aes(label = cpa), size = 2.3, color = "grey55") +
  geom_sf(data = st_transform(tr_cc, crs_map), fill = NA, color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.25) +
  { if (length(hatch)) geom_sf(data = st_transform(hatch, crs_map), color = "#7A5C00", linewidth = 0.2) } +
  geom_sf(data = st_transform(bd, crs_map), fill = NA, color = "black", linewidth = 1.1) +
  coord_sf(crs = crs_map, xlim = c(bbm[["xmin"]], bbm[["xmax"]]), ylim = c(bbm[["ymin"]], bbm[["ymax"]]), expand = FALSE, datum = NA) +
  labs(title = paste0(cc, " and its census tracts"),
       subtitle = sprintf("%d census tracts · %s sq ft (%s sq mi)", nrow(xw_cc), fmt(ls_cc$area_sqft), fmt(ls_cc$area_sqft / 27878400, 2)),
       caption = paste0("Bold line: CPA boundary. Thin lines: tracts with at least 50% of their land in the CPA.\nHatching: tract land outside the CPA (ACS data describe whole tracts). Dashed: neighboring CPAs.\n2020 census tracts (LA County eGIS); CPAs (City Planning).\n", basemap_credit)) +
  theme_void() + theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"), plot.caption = element_text(size = 7, hjust = 0))
print(g)
qa_add(7, paste0("Tract outline map has tracts, ", cc), ">0", nrow(tr_cc), nrow(tr_cc) > 0, stop_if_fail = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# ---- Eligible lots map: where the eligible lots are -----------------------------------------
lots <- p_cc %>% filter(eligA) %>% select(AIN, is_sf, is_mf, hillside_fire, hf_all, big45, ct20) %>%
  st_simplify(preserveTopology = TRUE, dTolerance = 5)   # simplified before embedding
n_vert <- sum(vapply(st_geometry(lots), function(gm) nrow(st_coordinates(gm)), 1L))
est_mb <- (n_vert * 20 + nrow(lots) * 40) / 1e6   # 5-decimal coordinates: about 20 bytes a vertex in the page
use_points <- est_mb > 8          # size budget: points if the polygons would exceed ~8 MB
if (use_points) lots <- st_point_on_surface(lots)
lots_ll <- to_ll(lots, digits = 5)
# Each lot is drawn once, in one of five groups per property type; the control restyles
# the groups for the tier chosen (filled, grey outline = removed by the screen, or hidden).
lot_kind <- with(lots_ll, case_when(big45 & !hf_all ~ "big_keep", big45 & !hillside_fire ~ "big_fx", big45 ~ "big_fl",
                                    !hf_all ~ "sm_keep", TRUE ~ "sm_fl"))
lot_grp <- paste0(ifelse(lots_ll$is_sf, "sf_", "mf_"), lot_kind)
tier_state <- list(A = c(big_keep = 1, big_fx = 1, big_fl = 1, sm_keep = 1, sm_fl = 1),      # 1 filled, 2 grey outline, 0 hidden
                   B = c(big_keep = 1, big_fx = 1, big_fl = 1, sm_keep = 0, sm_fl = 0),
                   C = c(big_keep = 1, big_fx = 1, big_fl = 2, sm_keep = 0, sm_fl = 0),
                   D = c(big_keep = 1, big_fx = 2, big_fl = 2, sm_keep = 1, sm_fl = 2))
col_sf <- "#3A6EA5"; col_mf <- "#8E5BB5"; col_rm <- "#7F7F7F"
tcount <- st_drop_geometry(p_cc) %>% group_by(ct20) %>%
  summarise(total = n(), sf_A = sum(sfA), sf_B = sum(sfB), sf_C = sum(sfC), sf_D = sum(sfD),
            all_A = sum(eligA), all_B = sum(eligB), all_C = sum(eligC), all_D = sum(eligD), .groups = "drop")
view_names <- c("sf_A", "sf_B", "sf_C", "sf_D", "all_A", "all_B", "all_C", "all_D")
tr_l3 <- tr_clip %>% left_join(tcount, by = c("CT20" = "ct20")) %>% mutate(across(c(total, all_of(view_names)), ~ coalesce(.x, 0L)))
tr_l3_ll <- to_ll(tr_l3); tr_pts_ll <- to_ll(st_point_on_surface(tr_l3))
pal_tr <- colorNumeric("Greens", domain = c(0, max(tr_l3$all_A, 1)))
grp_n <- table(factor(lot_grp, levels = as.vector(outer(c("sf_", "mf_"), names(tier_state$A), paste0))))
tier_from_groups <- sapply(names(tier_state), function(tt) sum(grp_n[as.vector(outer(c("sf_", "mf_"), names(tier_state[[tt]])[tier_state[[tt]] == 1], paste0))]))
qa_add(7, paste0("Eligible lots map: lots filled under each tier equal the land use summary (A / B / C / D), ", cc),
       paste(fmt(c(r$eA, r$eB, r$eC, r$eD)), collapse = " / "), paste(fmt(tier_from_groups), collapse = " / "),
       all(tier_from_groups == c(r$eA, r$eB, r$eC, r$eD)), stop_if_fail = TRUE)
add_lots <- function(m, sel, grp) {
  if (!any(sel)) return(m)
  d <- lots_ll[sel, ]
  if (use_points) addCircleMarkers(m, data = d, radius = 2, stroke = FALSE, color = col_rm, weight = 1, fill = TRUE,
                                   fillColor = col_sf, fillOpacity = 0.7, group = grp, options = pathOptions(interactive = FALSE))
  else addPolygons(m, data = d, weight = 0.3, color = col_sf, opacity = 0.9, fill = TRUE, fillColor = col_sf, fillOpacity = 0.55,
                   group = grp, options = pathOptions(interactive = FALSE))
}
lab_el <- sprintf(paste0("<b>Tract %s</b><br>Total parcels: %s<br>Eligible lots, single-family and multi-family: A %s &middot; B %s &middot; C %s &middot; D %s<br>",
                         "Eligible lots, single-family only: A %s &middot; B %s &middot; C %s &middot; D %s"),
                  tr_l3_ll$LABEL, fmt(tr_l3_ll$total), fmt(tr_l3_ll$all_A), fmt(tr_l3_ll$all_B), fmt(tr_l3_ll$all_C), fmt(tr_l3_ll$all_D),
                  fmt(tr_l3_ll$sf_A), fmt(tr_l3_ll$sf_B), fmt(tr_l3_ll$sf_C), fmt(tr_l3_ll$sf_D))
m <- leaflet_base(bm_key = cpa_key(cc)) %>% fit_to(bd) %>%
  addPolygons(data = to_ll(bd), fill = FALSE, color = "black", weight = 2.5,
              options = pathOptions(interactive = FALSE)) %>%   # outline only: hover reaches the layer below
  addPolygons(data = tr_l3_ll, layerId = paste0("el_", tr_l3_ll$CT20), fillColor = pal_tr(tr_l3_ll$sf_B), fillOpacity = 0.35,
              color = "#444444", weight = 0.8, label = lapply(lab_el, HTML)) %>%
  addLabelOnlyMarkers(data = tr_pts_ll, label = fmt(tr_pts_ll$sf_B), group = "el_lab",
                      labelOptions = labelOptions(noHide = TRUE, textOnly = TRUE, direction = "center", style = label_style))
for (g in names(grp_n)[grp_n > 0]) m <- add_lots(m, lot_grp == g, g)
el_data <- list(states = lapply(tier_state, as.list), groups = names(grp_n)[grp_n > 0], points = use_points,
                ids = paste0("el_", tr_l3_ll$CT20), col_sf = col_sf, col_mf = col_mf, col_rm = col_rm,
                tr = setNames(lapply(view_names, function(v) list(val = fmt(tr_l3_ll[[v]]), col = pal_tr(tr_l3_ll[[v]]))), view_names))
m <- m %>%
  addLegend("bottomright", colors = c(col_sf, col_mf, col_rm),
            labels = c("Eligible single-family lot", "Eligible multi-family lot", "Removed by the hillside-fire screen (outline)"), opacity = 0.8) %>%
  onRender("
    function(el, x, data) {
      var map = this, nm = el.id, labs = [];
      function arr(v) { return Array.isArray(v) ? v : [v]; }
      var lgl = map.layerManager.getLayerGroup('el_lab', false);
      if (lgl) lgl.eachLayer(function(l) { labs.push(l); });
      var ctrl = L.control({position: 'topright'});
      ctrl.onAdd = function() {
        var div = L.DomUtil.create('div', 'leaflet-bar');
        div.style.background = 'white'; div.style.padding = '6px 8px'; div.style.fontSize = '12px';
        div.innerHTML = '<b>Property type</b><br>' +
          '<label><input type=\"radio\" name=\"' + nm + '_pt\" value=\"sf\" checked> Single-family</label><br>' +
          '<label><input type=\"radio\" name=\"' + nm + '_pt\" value=\"all\"> All eligible</label><br>' +
          '<b>Tier</b><br>' +
          '<label><input type=\"radio\" name=\"' + nm + '_sc\" value=\"A\"> A: 4,000 sq ft +</label><br>' +
          '<label><input type=\"radio\" name=\"' + nm + '_sc\" value=\"B\" checked> B: 4,500 sq ft +</label><br>' +
          '<label><input type=\"radio\" name=\"' + nm + '_sc\" value=\"C\"> C: B less hillside-fire lots</label><br>' +
          '<label><input type=\"radio\" name=\"' + nm + '_sc\" value=\"D\"> D: A less hillside-fire lots, no exemption</label>';
        L.DomEvent.disableClickPropagation(div);
        return div;
      };
      ctrl.addTo(map);
      function update() {
        var pt = el.querySelector('input[name=\"' + nm + '_pt\"]:checked').value;
        var sc = el.querySelector('input[name=\"' + nm + '_sc\"]:checked').value;
        arr(data.groups).forEach(function(g) {
          var lg = map.layerManager.getLayerGroup(g, false); if (!lg) return;
          var isSf = g.indexOf('sf_') === 0, st = +data.states[sc][g.substring(3)];
          if (st === 0 || (pt === 'sf' && !isSf)) { map.removeLayer(lg); return; }
          var col = isSf ? data.col_sf : data.col_mf, sty;
          if (data.points) sty = st === 2 ? {stroke: true, color: data.col_rm, weight: 1, fill: false}
                                          : {stroke: false, fill: true, fillColor: col, fillOpacity: 0.7};
          else sty = st === 2 ? {weight: 0.8, color: data.col_rm, opacity: 0.9, fill: false}
                              : {weight: 0.3, color: col, opacity: 0.9, fill: true, fillColor: col, fillOpacity: 0.55};
          lg.eachLayer(function(l) { l.setStyle(sty); });
          if (!map.hasLayer(lg)) map.addLayer(lg);
        });
        var v = data.tr[pt + '_' + sc], vals = arr(v.val), cols = arr(v.col), ids = arr(data.ids);
        ids.forEach(function(id, i) { var l = map.layerManager.getLayer('shape', id); if (l) l.setStyle({fillColor: cols[i]}); });
        labs.forEach(function(l, i) { l.setTooltipContent(String(vals[i])); });
      }
      el.addEventListener('change', update);
      update();
    }", data = el_data)
qa_add(7, paste0("Eligible lots map has lots, ", cc), ">0", fmt(nrow(lots)), nrow(lots) > 0, stop_if_fail = TRUE)
tagList(tags$p(tags$b(paste0("Eligible lots, ", cc))), m,
        tags$p(style = "font-size: 12px;",
               paste0("Use the controls to switch property type and tier; the map opens on tier B, the 4,500 sq ft floor used in the rest of this section. Under tiers C and D, lots the hillside-fire screen removes are grey outlines; lots of 4,000 to 4,499 sq ft appear under tiers A and D only. Tracts (clipped to the CPA) are shaded by eligible lots in the current view, with the count printed; hover over a tract for every tier at once. Lots drawn as ",
                      if (use_points) "points (size budget)" else "simplified parcel outlines", ". ", basemap_credit, ".")))
```

### ADUs

```{r}
# ---- ADU units by status ---------------------------------------------------
s <- as_cc
qa_add(7, paste0("ADU units by status: completed + in progress + stalled = total units, ", cc), fmt(s$units),
       fmt(s$completed + s$in_progress + s$stalled), s$completed + s$in_progress + s$stalled == s$units, stop_if_fail = TRUE)
qa_add(7, paste0("ADU units by status: the CPA has ADU units, ", cc), ">0", fmt(s$units), s$units > 0, stop_if_fail = TRUE)
status_tbl <- function(s, what) {
  v <- c(s$units, s$completed, s$in_progress, s$stalled, s$outside_A, s$outside_B, s$outside_C, s$outside_D)
  tibble(Row = c(paste0("Total ADU units, ", window_label), "Completed", "In progress", "Stalled",
                 "Outside tier A: units on lots under 4,000 sq ft",
                 "Outside tier B: units on lots under 4,500 sq ft",
                 "Outside tier C: units on lots under 4,500 sq ft, or on any lot flagged hillside-fire",
                 "Outside tier D: units on lots under 4,000 sq ft, or on any lot in both the hillside and fire layers"),
         `ADU units` = fmt(v), `Share of total` = pct(v / s$units)) %>%
    tbl(caption = paste0("ADU units by status, ", cc, ", ", what, " (ADU units)"),
        note = paste0(fmt(s$projects), " ADUs, all tags counted together. Projects are placed by their parcel's location. Status: completed = CofO, final inspection or CofC anywhere in the permit chain; stalled = no change in permit status since ",
                      format(stall_cutoff, "%B %e, %Y") %>% str_squish(), " (three years or more); in progress = all other active projects. The four \"outside\" rows count units on single-family or multi-family lots a tier leaves out; they are already counted in the total and status rows."))
}
qa_add(7, paste0("ADU units by status: single-family version adds up and does not exceed the all-property version, ", cc), "holds", "checked",
       as_sf_cc$completed + as_sf_cc$in_progress + as_sf_cc$stalled == as_sf_cc$units && as_sf_cc$units <= s$units &&
         as_sf_cc$units == sum(a_cc$units[a_cc$property_type == "Single-family"]), stop_if_fail = TRUE)
sf_switch(status_tbl(s, "all properties"), status_tbl(as_sf_cc, "single-family properties only"))
```

The counts above include every ADU tag: `r fmt(tag_cc$n[1])` units on LADBS permitted ADUs (2017 to present), `r fmt(tag_cc$n[2])` on older permitted ADUs (2010 to 2016) and `r fmt(tag_cc$n[3])` grandfathered ADUs from the Assessor roll, which count as completed. See the table of ADUs by tag under [ADU identification](#adu-identification).

```{r}
# ---- Properties with ADUs, then unit status by property type --------------
other_props <- s$properties - s$prop_sf - s$prop_mf
qa_add(7, paste0("ADUs by property type: property rows sum to the total, ", cc), fmt(s$properties), fmt(s$prop_sf + s$prop_mf + other_props),
       other_props >= 0, stop_if_fail = TRUE)
units_by <- function(d) c(sum(d$units), sum(d$units[d$status == "Completed"]),
                          sum(d$units[d$status == "In progress"]), sum(d$units[d$status == "Stalled"]))
u_sf <- units_by(filter(a_cc, property_type == "Single-family")); u_mf <- units_by(filter(a_cc, property_type == "Multi-family"))
u_ot <- units_by(filter(a_cc, !property_type %in% c("Single-family", "Multi-family"))); u_all <- units_by(a_cc)
for (nm in c("single-family", "multi-family")) {
  v <- if (nm == "single-family") u_sf else u_mf
  qa_add(7, paste0("ADUs by property type: ", nm, " status columns sum to the units, ", cc), fmt(v[1]), fmt(sum(v[-1])), sum(v[-1]) == v[1], stop_if_fail = TRUE)
}
qa_add(7, paste0("ADUs by property type: unit rows sum to the status table total, by status, ", cc), paste(fmt(u_all), collapse = " / "),
       paste(fmt(u_sf + u_mf + u_ot), collapse = " / "),
       all(u_sf + u_mf + u_ot == u_all) && all(u_all == c(s$units, s$completed, s$in_progress, s$stalled)), stop_if_fail = TRUE)
a2 <- rbind(u_all, u_sf, u_mf, u_ot)
props <- c(s$properties, s$prop_sf, s$prop_mf, other_props)
tibble(`Property type` = c("All properties with ADUs", "Single-family properties", "Multi-family properties", "Other or unknown"),
       `Properties with ADUs` = fmt(props), `Share of properties` = pct(props / s$properties),
       `ADU units` = fmt(a2[, 1]), Completed = fmt(a2[, 2]), `In progress` = fmt(a2[, 3]), Stalled = fmt(a2[, 4]),
       `Share completed` = ifelse(a2[, 1] > 0, pct(a2[, 2] / pmax(a2[, 1], 1)), "n/a")) %>%
  tbl(caption = paste0("Properties with ADUs and ADU units by status, by property type, ", cc),
      note = "Properties are parcels with at least one ADU project; the unit columns count ADU units on those properties, and completed + in progress + stalled = ADU units. Property type is the parcel's land use class from the 2026 roll (the same source as the lot counts), so it reflects use in 2026, not at the permit date. Other or unknown: other parcel classes, plus projects placed on no parcel (each counted once); for those, a permit sub-type of Apartment counts as multi-family.",
      align = c("l", rep("r", 7)))
```

```{r}
# ---- Cumulative units by year, with a year slider ------------------
ch_sf <- dated_chart(a_cc %>% filter(property_type == "Single-family"),
                     paste0("Cumulative ADU units by year, single-family properties, ", cc))  # shown one at a time, with a toggle
ch_mf <- dated_chart(a_cc %>% filter(property_type == "Multi-family"),
                     paste0("Cumulative ADU units by year, multi-family properties, ", cc))
for (tp in c("Single-family", "Multi-family")) {      # reconciliation with the property-type table
  bars <- if (tp == "Single-family") ch_sf$bars else ch_mf$bars
  last <- bars[bars$year == max(bars$year), ]
  d <- a_cc %>% filter(property_type == tp)
  ok <- last$Completed == sum(d$units[d$status == "Completed"]) &&
    last$New + last$Ongoing == sum(d$units[d$status %in% c("In progress", "Stalled")])
  qa_add(7, paste0("Cumulative charts reconciliation, ", tolower(tp), ", ", cc, ": last bar matches the property-type table"),
         "matches", if (ok) "matches" else "differs", ok, stop_if_fail = TRUE)
}
chart_notes <- tags$ul(style = "font-size: 12px;",
  tags$li(sprintf("Each bar is every ADU unit submitted by the end of that year, so the bars accumulate. Completed: completion date on or before December 31 (CofO date; else the date of the CofO, final-inspection or CofC status). New: first submitted that year and not completed by its end. Ongoing: submitted earlier and not completed by its end. %s* runs to %s.",
                  year(data_asof), format(data_asof, "%B %e") %>% str_squish())),
  tags$li("Projects later dropped as not active never appear, so earlier bars show only projects that are alive or completed today."),
  tags$li("Stalled cannot be shown for past years: the extracts keep only each permit's latest status date."),
  tags$li(sprintf("Permits submitted but not issued by %s are not in the data. Submitted = the earliest SUBMITTED_DATE in the chain (the issue date where it is blank); projects submitted before 2017 enter the 2017 bar as ongoing.",
                  format(data_asof, "%B %e, %Y") %>% str_squish())))
chart_notes <- tagAppendChild(chart_notes, tags$li("Older permitted ADUs (2010 to 2016) enter the 2017 bar as completed or ongoing. Grandfathered ADUs have no dates and are counted as completed in every bar."))
tagList(chart_switch(ch_sf$widget, ch_mf$widget), chart_notes)
```

```{r}
# ---- Layered tract map: homeowners by group, with ADUs on top ----------------------
ly <- tr_full %>% left_join(tstat, by = c("CT20" = "ct20")) %>%
  mutate(across(c(units, units_sf, comp, prog, stal), ~ coalesce(as.numeric(.x), 0)))
hi_class <- function(g) {
  o <- ly$own_est >= lay_high; gg <- ly[[paste0(g, "_est")]] >= lay_high
  case_when(ly[[paste0(g, "_grey")]] | ly$own_grey ~ hh_levels[5], o & gg ~ hh_levels[1], o & !gg ~ hh_levels[2],
            !o & gg ~ hh_levels[3], TRUE ~ hh_levels[4])
}
ly$hi_lat <- hi_class("lat"); ly$hi_blk <- hi_class("blk")
adu_cut <- median(ly$units)                     # the middle tract of this CPA on ADU units
adu_cut_sf <- median(ly$units_sf)               # the same middle tract, on units on single-family properties
ly <- ly %>% mutate(many_adu = units >= adu_cut & units > 0,
                    focus_lat = hi_lat == hh_levels[1] & many_adu, focus_blk = hi_blk == hh_levels[1] & many_adu,
                    many_adu_sf = units_sf >= adu_cut_sf & units_sf > 0, many_adu_sf6 = units_sf >= pooled_cut_sf & units_sf > 0,
                    focus_lat_sf = hi_lat == hh_levels[1] & many_adu_sf, focus_blk_sf = hi_blk == hh_levels[1] & many_adu_sf)
qa_add(7, paste0("Layered tract map has every tract, ", cc), nrow(xw_cc), nrow(ly), nrow(ly) == nrow(xw_cc), stop_if_fail = TRUE)
qa_add(7, paste0("Layered tract map: ADU units by tract sum to the units in the CPA's tracts, ", cc),
       fmt(sum(a_cc$units[a_cc$ct20 %in% xw_cc$CT20])), fmt(sum(ly$units)),
       sum(ly$units) == sum(a_cc$units[a_cc$ct20 %in% xw_cc$CT20]), stop_if_fail = TRUE)
qa_add(7, paste0("Layered tract map: focus tracts all have both rates at 50% or more and ADU units at or above the CPA's middle tract, ", cc),
       "all", "checked",
       all(ly$own_est[ly$focus_lat | ly$focus_blk] >= 0.5) && all(ly$lat_est[ly$focus_lat] >= 0.5) &&
         all(ly$blk_est[ly$focus_blk] >= 0.5) && all(ly$units[ly$focus_lat | ly$focus_blk] >= adu_cut), stop_if_fail = TRUE)
nmv <- function(v) as.list(setNames(v, ly$GEOID))
ly_cols <- list(
  latn = nmv(lay_cnt_pal$lat(ly$lat_num)), blkn = nmv(lay_cnt_pal$blk(ly$blk_num)),
  own = nmv(ifelse(ly$own_grey, "#D9D9D9", d2_pal$own(ly$own_est))),
  lat = nmv(ifelse(ly$lat_grey, "#D9D9D9", d2_pal$lat(ly$lat_est))),
  blk = nmv(ifelse(ly$blk_grey, "#D9D9D9", d2_pal$blk(ly$blk_est))),
  hil = nmv(unname(hh_cols[ly$hi_lat])), hib = nmv(unname(hh_cols[ly$hi_blk])),
  wc = nmv(unname(wc_cols[as.character(ly$class_lab)])), wch = nmv(unname(wc_cols[as.character(ly$class_hh)])),
  incm = nmv(inc_col(ly$mfi_ratio)), inch = nmv(inc_col(ly$mhi_ratio)),
  dlo = nmv(chg_col(ly$chg_lat_own, ly$sig_lat_own, chg_n_breaks)), dbo = nmv(chg_col(ly$chg_blk_own, ly$sig_blk_own, chg_n_breaks)),
  dlr = nmv(chg_col(ly$chg_lat_rate, ly$sig_lat_rate, chg_s_breaks)), dbr = nmv(chg_col(ly$chg_blk_rate, ly$sig_blk_rate, chg_s_breaks)),
  dls = nmv(chg_col(ly$chg_lat_shr, ly$sig_lat_shr, chg_s_breaks)), dbs = nmv(chg_col(ly$chg_blk_shr, ly$sig_blk_shr, chg_s_breaks)),
  none = nmv(rep("#FFFFFF", nrow(ly))))
ly_dash <- list(incm = nmv(ly$mfi_cross), inch = nmv(ly$mhi_cross))     # 90% range of the ratio crosses 1.00
ly_inc <- function(v, r, m) ifelse(is.na(v), "not published", sprintf("$%s, ratio %s &plusmn; %s", fmt(v), fmt(r, 2), fmt(m, 2)))
ly_chg <- function(g) {
  e19 <- ly[[paste0("est19_", g, "_own")]]; e24 <- ly[[paste0("est24_", g, "_own")]]
  d <- ly[[paste0("chg_", g, "_own")]]; dm <- ly[[paste0("chg_moe_", g, "_own")]]; sg <- ly[[paste0("sig_", g, "_own")]]
  s19 <- ly[[paste0("est19_", g, "_shr")]]; s24 <- ly[[paste0("est24_", g, "_shr")]]
  sd <- ly[[paste0("chg_", g, "_shr")]]; sm <- ly[[paste0("chg_moe_", g, "_shr")]]; ss <- ly[[paste0("sig_", g, "_shr")]]
  r19 <- ly[[paste0("est19_", g, "_rate")]]; r24 <- ly[[paste0("est24_", g, "_rate")]]
  rd <- ly[[paste0("chg_", g, "_rate")]]; rm <- ly[[paste0("chg_moe_", g, "_rate")]]; rs <- ly[[paste0("sig_", g, "_rate")]]
  rate_txt <- ifelse(is.na(rd), "homeownership rate n/a",
                     sprintf("homeownership rate %s &rarr; %s (%s%s &plusmn; %s pts%s)", pct(r19), pct(r24), ifelse(rd > 0, "+", ""), fmt(100 * rd, 1), fmt(100 * rm, 1),
                             ifelse(rs, ", <b>significant</b>", ", within the margin")))
  sprintf("%s; owners %s &rarr; %s (%s%s &plusmn; %s%s); share of owners %s &rarr; %s (%s%s &plusmn; %s pts%s)", rate_txt,
          fmt(e19), fmt(e24), ifelse(d > 0, "+", ""), fmt(d), fmt(dm), ifelse(sg, "", ", within the margin"),
          pct(s19), pct(s24), ifelse(sd > 0, "+", ""), fmt(100 * sd, 1), fmt(100 * sm, 1), ifelse(ss, "", ", within the margin"))
}
ly_pr <- function(e, m, g) ifelse(is.na(e), "n/a", paste0(fmt(100 * e, 1), "% ± ", fmt(100 * m, 1), ifelse(g, " (few households or unreliable)", "")))
ly_hover <- sprintf(paste0("<b>Tract %s</b> · %s<br>",
                           "Households: %s · owners: %s · homeownership rate %s<br>",
                           "Latino households: %s · Latino owners: <b>%s</b> · rate %s<br>",
                           "Black households: %s · Black owners: <b>%s</b> · rate %s<br>",
                           "ADU units: <b>%s</b> (completed %s, in progress %s, stalled %s; on single-family properties %s)<br>",
                           "Median family income: %s &middot; median household income: %s<br>",
                           "Tract class, county-median option: %s<br>",
                           "Change 2015&ndash;2019 to 2020&ndash;2024%s: Latino %s<br>Black %s%s"),
                    ly$LABEL, ly$class_lab, fmt(ly$own_den), fmt(ly$own_num), ly_pr(ly$own_est, ly$own_moe, ly$own_grey),
                    fmt(ly$lat_den), fmt(ly$lat_num), ly_pr(ly$lat_est, ly$lat_moe, ly$lat_grey),
                    fmt(ly$blk_den), fmt(ly$blk_num), ly_pr(ly$blk_est, ly$blk_moe, ly$blk_grey),
                    fmt(ly$units), fmt(ly$comp), fmt(ly$prog), fmt(ly$stal), fmt(ly$units_sf),
                    ly_inc(ly$mfi, ly$mfi_ratio, ly$mfi_ratio_moe), ly_inc(ly$mhi, ly$mhi_ratio, ly$mhi_ratio_moe), ly$class_hh,
                    ifelse(ly$chg_n20 == 1 & ly$chg_n10 == 1, "", sprintf(" (group of %d tracts in 2020, %d in 2010)", ly$chg_n20, ly$chg_n10)),
                    ly_chg("lat"), ly_chg("blk"),
                    ifelse(ly$focus_lat | ly$focus_blk,
                           paste0("<br><i>Focus tract: homeownership and ",
                                  ifelse(ly$focus_lat & ly$focus_blk, "Latino and Black", ifelse(ly$focus_lat, "Latino", "Black")),
                                  " homeownership 50% or more, and ADU units at or above the CPA's middle tract</i>"), ""))
g_fl <- "Focus: Latino owners + ADUs"; g_fb <- "Focus: Black owners + ADUs"; g_n <- "ADU units per tract"
b_ly <- st_bbox(to_ll(bd)); ctr_ly <- suppressWarnings(st_point_on_surface(ly))
mL <- leaflet_base(height = 680, bm_key = cpa_key(cc)) %>%
  fitBounds(b_ly[["xmin"]], b_ly[["ymin"]], b_ly[["xmax"]], b_ly[["ymax"]], options = list(padding = c(25, 25))) %>%
  addPolygons(data = ly, layerId = ~GEOID, fillColor = unlist(ly_cols$latn, use.names = FALSE), fillOpacity = 0.72,
              color = "#555555", weight = 0.7, label = lapply(ly_hover, HTML)) %>%
  addPolygons(data = to_ll(bd), fill = FALSE, color = "black", weight = 2.5,
              options = pathOptions(interactive = FALSE))   # outline only: hover reaches the layer below
sf_grpL <- list()      # layers the single-family control shows or hides, group by group
add_focus <- function(m, a, b, grp, color, dash = NULL) {       # outlines for both versions, drawn once each
  if (!any(a | b)) return(m)
  d <- rbind(ly[a, ], ly[b, ])
  sf_grpL[[grp]] <<- list(all = c(rep(1L, sum(a)), rep(0L, sum(b))), sf = c(rep(0L, sum(a)), rep(1L, sum(b))))
  addPolygons(m, data = d, fill = FALSE, color = color, weight = 3.5, dashArray = dash, group = grp, options = pathOptions(interactive = FALSE))
}
mL <- mL %>% add_focus(ly$focus_lat, ly$focus_lat_sf, g_fl, "#D7191C") %>%
  add_focus(ly$focus_blk, ly$focus_blk_sf, g_fb, "#7B3294", dash = "6,4")
mL <- mL %>% addLabelOnlyMarkers(data = ctr_ly, label = fmt(ctr_ly$units), group = g_n,

for (stt in status_levels) {

}
ov_ly <- c(paste0("ADUs: ", status_levels[status_levels %in% pts_cc$status]), g_n,
           if (any(ly$focus_lat | ly$focus_lat_sf)) g_fl, if (any(ly$focus_blk | ly$focus_blk_sf)) g_fb)

qa_add(7, paste0("Layered tract map: single-family focus tracts have both rates at 50% or more and single-family units at or above the CPA's middle tract, ", cc),
       "all", "checked", all(ly$units_sf[ly$focus_lat_sf | ly$focus_blk_sf] >= adu_cut_sf) && all(ly$own_est[ly$focus_lat_sf | ly$focus_blk_sf] >= 0.5), stop_if_fail = TRUE)
qa_add(7, paste0("Layered tract map: every tract has an income band or is marked not published, both measures, ", cc), nrow(ly),

n_fl <- sum(ly$focus_lat); n_fb <- sum(ly$focus_blk)
tr_word <- function(n) if (n == 0) "no tracts" else if (n == 1) "1 tract" else paste(n, "tracts")
ly_tab <- ly %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% arrange(desc(lat_num + blk_num)) %>%
  transmute(Tract = LABEL, Class = as.character(class_lab), Households = fmt(own_den),

            `Family income ÷ metro median` = ifelse(is.na(mfi_ratio), "n/a", fmt(mfi_ratio, 2)),

  kable(format = "html", align = c("l", "l", rep("r", 7), "l", "r", "l", "l", rep("r", 8))) %>%

tagList(

",
                "Income layers: tract median family income ÷ the metro median ($", fmt(metro_mfi), ") and tract median household income ÷ the county median ($", fmt(county_mhi), "), in six bands; a dashed outline marks tracts whose 90% range crosses 1.00 (the margin treats the metro or county median as fixed). \"Working-class tracts, county-median option\" applies tests A and B with household income against the county median for test C. ",
```

```{r}
qa_add(7, paste0("Working-class tables built with the confirmed rule, ", cc), "tracts > 0", nrow(tc_cc), nrow(tc_cc) > 0, stop_if_fail = TRUE)
```

`r cc` has `r n_wc` working-class tracts, `r n_oth` other tracts`r if (n_ins > 0) paste0(" and ", n_ins, " with insufficient data") else ""`. `r if (n_oth == 0) "With no other tracts, the comparison columns for other tracts are empty here; the six-CPA rows under Decision points (decision 4) carry the finding." else if (n_oth < 5) paste0("With only ", n_oth, " other tract", ifelse(n_oth == 1, "", "s"), ", the comparison is thin here; the six-CPA rows under Decision points (decision 4) carry the finding.") else ""`

```{r}
d3_table(res3, caption = paste0("Demographics of working-class and other tracts, ", cc),
         note = paste("ACS 2020–2024 5-year. Group values come from counts summed over each group's tracts, never from averaging tract rates. MOE = 90% margin of error (shares in percentage points); † = low reliability.",
                      "The class describes a tract's residents, not the owner of any ADU in it."))
d4_note <- function(sf) paste0(if (sf) "Single-family version: ADU units on single-family properties, per 100 single-family eligible lots, so both sides of the ratio count the same kind of lot. " else "",
                    "ADU projects and lots on parcels inside the CPA whose tract is assigned to this CPA. ",
                    fmt(n_left_parcels), " parcels in the CPA lie in tracts assigned elsewhere (", fmt(n_left_units),
                    " ADU units); they count in every CPA total but not here. Tier B: lots of 4,500 sq ft or more; tier C: tier B less lots flagged hillside-fire. ", grp_note,
                    " The class describes a tract's residents, not the owner of any ADU in it.")
qa_add(7, paste0("ADUs in working-class and other tracts: single-family units do not exceed all units in any group, ", cc), "holds", "checked",
       all(d4_sf$units <= d4$units) && all(d4_sf$eligB <= d4$eligB), stop_if_fail = TRUE)
sf_switch(d4_table(d4) %>% tbl(caption = paste0("ADUs in working-class and other tracts, ", cc, ", all properties"), note = d4_note(FALSE), align = c("l", rep("r", 4))),
          d4_table(d4_sf, sf_only = TRUE) %>% tbl(caption = paste0("ADUs in working-class and other tracts, ", cc, ", single-family properties only"), note = d4_note(TRUE), align = c("l", rep("r", 4))))
```
